# Kandalama.lk

> Sri Lanka's online real estate and property marketplace for buying, selling, and renting houses, lands, commercial properties, rooms, and annexes across all 25 districts.

## Key Offerings
- **Property Categories**: Houses (`house`), Lands (`land`), Commercial Properties (`commercial`), Rooms & Boarding (`room`), and Annexes (`annex`).
- **Transaction Types**: For Sale (`sale`) and For Rent (`rent`).
- **Currency**: Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR).
- **Geographic Coverage**: All 25 districts in Sri Lanka, including Colombo, Gampaha, Kalutara, Kandy, Galle, Matara, Kurunegala, and Negombo.
- **Languages**: English, Sinhala, and Tamil.

## Important URLs
- Homepage: https://kandalama.app
- Browse All Properties: https://kandalama.app/properties
- Houses: https://kandalama.app/properties?category=house
- Annexes: https://kandalama.app/properties?category=annex
- Rooms & Boarding: https://kandalama.app/properties?category=room
- Land: https://kandalama.app/properties?category=land
- Commercial Properties: https://kandalama.app/properties?category=commercial
- Rentals: https://kandalama.app/properties?listing_type=rent
- Properties for Sale: https://kandalama.app/properties?listing_type=sale
- Sri Lanka Property & Rental Guide (FAQ): https://kandalama.app/guide
- About Kandalama.lk: https://kandalama.app/about
- Post a Property Ad: https://kandalama.app/post-ad
